content_sections.heading: Amrita Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee, the age limit, the pay or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university, and this vacancy is at its campus in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Its website lists undergraduate, postgraduate, integrated, doctoral and online programmes across campuses that include Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kochi and Mysuru.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Administrative Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in regular mode Basic knowledge of university examination systems and academic regulations Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, email applications) Good written and verbal communication skills Ability to handle confidential academic records with integrity Degree preferably in computer science, mathematics, physics, chemistry or data science Familiarity with ERP / student information systems (desirable) See the official notification for the full eligibility details of this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in planning, scheduling and coordinating examinations Prepare, verify and maintain examination records and student data Support activities related to answer script management and valuation processes Assist in hall ticket generation, seating arrangements and examination logistics Handle student queries related to examinations, results, revaluation and certificates Maintain confidentiality of examination materials and sensitive data Perform other duties assigned by the Controller of Examinations / Deputy Controller of Examinations

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Administrative Assistant job page on the Amrita website. Use the Apply Online option on that page and submit your application before the last date.

faq.question: Q1. Must the Bachelor's Degree be in regular mode?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice asks for a Bachelor's Degree in regular mode.

faq.question: Q2. Which degree subjects are preferred?
faq.answer: The notice prefers computer science, mathematics, physics, chemistry and data science.

faq.question: Q3. Is ERP experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Familiarity with ERP or student information systems is listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Which computer skills are needed?
faq.answer: Candidates need proficiency in MS Office, specifically Word, Excel and email applications.

faq.question: Q5. Who assigns additional duties to an Administrative Assistant?
faq.answer: Other duties may be assigned by the Controller of Examinations or the Deputy Controller of Examinations.

faq.question: Q6. Where can candidates send questions about this vacancy?
faq.answer: For details, the notice gives the email address [email protected].
